6.
(1) Any person who conspires to commit an offence
under  this  Act  shall  be  guilty  of  an  offence  and  shall,  on
conviction after trial before the High Court be liable to be
punished  with  the  punishment  prescribed  for  abetting  the
commission of that offence.
(2) The term “conspire” shall have the same meaning as in
section  113A  (2)  of  the  Penal  Code  (Chapter  19)  and  the
provisions  of  that  section  shall  mutatis  mutandis  apply  in
relation to a conspiracy to commit an offence under this Act.
PART II
INVESTIGATION

7.
Except as otherwise provided in this Act, all offences
under this Act shall be investigated, tried or otherwise dealt
with in accordance with the provisions of the Code of Criminal
Procedure Act, No. 15 of 1979.
